findings: A merged scientific correction is not full benchmark resolution until independent audit passes.
Workflow-level success with a skipped required job does not establish scientific release readiness.
Product completion requires end-to-end user acceptance, not feature presence alone.
An audit can produce internally consistent counts while comparing semantically different identifiers; join keys must be justified from the source schema/ReadMe.
A zero-row parse of an external reference is an input-format failure; it must never be interpreted as a real empty reference set or used to report membership metrics.
